generatedFrom.title: Legitimate dunning
generatedFrom.narrative: A subscription biller retrying failed renewals on a schedule, the same small set of cards over and over.
generatedFrom.correlation: A few cards, many attempts each, on a regular cadence. One merchant system, not one shopper.
generatedFrom.recommendedAction: Nothing, or a note to whoever owns the retry schedule. Blocking would stop the merchant collecting money it is owed.
generatedFrom.difficulty: Stripe warns that aggressive dunning looks exactly like card testing. The tell is inverted: an attack tries many cards a few times, dunning tries few cards many times. A detector keyed on raw failure volume cannot tell them apart at all.
